title: Book of Mazarbul
gametext:
Tale. Bearer must be a Dwarf.
At the start of each fellowship phase when the fellowship is at site 4 or higher, you may draw a card for each Dwarf companion.
lore: 'It seems to be a record of the fortunes of Balin's folk....'

title: Gimli's Pipe
gametext:
Bearer must be Gimli.
Fellowship: Exert Gimli to add 1 to the number of pipes you can spot.
lore: 'And certainly it was from Bree that the art of smoking the genuine weed spread in the recent centuries among Dwarves and such other folk....'

title: Mines of Khazad-Dûm
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Each time you play a [dwarven] tale, you may heal a Dwarf companion.
lore: 'Moria! Moria! Wonder of the Northern world!'

title: A Royal Welcome
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Regroup: Exert a Dwarf ally to heal a Dwarf companion.
lore: 'There is even a chance that Dwarves are there, and that in some deep hall of his fathers, Balin son of Fundin may be found.'

title: Song of Durin
gametext:
Tale. To play, exert a Dwarf. Plays to your support area.
The twilight cost of each [moria] weapon is +2.
Fellowship: Discard this condition to discard up to 2 [moria] conditions.
lore: No harp is wrung, no hammer falls: / The darkness dwells in Durin's halls....

title: Storm of Argument
gametext: Fellowship: Reveal a card at random from an opponent's hand. Shuffle up to X [dwarven] cards from your discard pile into your draw deck, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
lore: 'I will be dead before I see the Ring in the hands of an Elf!'

title: Arwen
gametext:
Ranger.
Response: If the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound, discard 3 cards from hand to prevent that wound.
lore: 'If I can cross the river, the power of my people will protect him.'
subtitle: Elven Rider

title: Arwen
gametext: While you can spot 3 [elven] allies whose home is site 3, each minion skirmishing Arwen is strength -3.
lore: Queenly she looked, and thought and knowledge were in her glance, as of one who has known many things that the years bring.
subtitle: Lady Undómiel

title: Beren and Lúthien
gametext:
Tale. Plays to your support area.
Skirmish: Exert an [elven] ally to discard the bottom card of your draw deck. If that card is an [elven] card, make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength -1.
lore: 'Tinúviel! Tinúviel! / He called her by her elvish name; / And there she halted listening.'

title: Calaglin
gametext:
Archer.
Regroup: Exert Calaglin to wound a minion.
lore: 'We have been keeping watch on the rivers, ever since we saw a great troop of Orcs going north toward Moria....'
subtitle: Elf of Lórien

title: Cast It Into the Fire!
gametext: Maneuver: Spot an Elf to make each opponent discard a card from his or her hand. Draw a card for each card discarded in this way.
lore: 'It should have been cast then into Orodruin's fire nigh at hand where it was made.'

title: Dínendal
gametext:
Archer.
Regroup: Exert Dínendal to remove (2).
lore: He was almost certain that he could hear stealthy movements.... Not Elves; for the woodland folk were altogether noiseless in their movements.
subtitle: Silent Scout

title: Elrond
gametext:
At the start of each of your turns, you may spot an ally whose home is site 3 and heal that ally up to 2 times.
Regroup: Exert Elrond twice to heal a companion.
lore: Venerable he seemed as a king crowned with many winters, and yet hale as a tried warrior....

effect.text: Choose an ally to heal up to 2 times
Choose how many times to heal {healingAlly}

subtitle: Herald to Gil-galad

title: Erestor
gametext:
To play, spot an Elf.
Response: If an Elf is about to take a wound from a [sauron] minion or [sauron] event, exert Erestor to prevent that wound.
lore: 'Then there are but two courses... to hide the Ring for ever, or to unmake it.'
subtitle: Chief Advisor to Elrond

title: Forests of Lothlórien
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Each time the fellowship moves, you may spot 3 [elven] allies to wound a minion.
lore: 'Alas for Lothlórien that I love! It would be a poor life in a land where no mallorn grew.'

title: Friends of Old
gametext: Fellowship: Reveal a card at random from an opponent's hand. Heal X [elven] allies, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
lore: 'You have been summoned here to answer the threat of Mordor.'

title: Galadriel
gametext:
At the start of each of your turns, you may heal an Elf.
Fellowship: Exert Galadriel to play the fellowship's next site if it is a forest (replacing opponent's site if necessary).
lore: 'There is in her and in this land no evil, unless a man bring it hither himself. Then let him beware!'
subtitle: Lady of the Golden Wood

title: Galdor
gametext:
To play, spot an Elf.
Regroup: Exert Galdor and spot a minion to return that minion to its owner's hand.
lore: 'My heart tells me that Sauron will expect us to take the western way, when he learns what has befallen. He soon will.'
subtitle: Councilor From the West

title: Gift of the Evenstar
gametext:
To play, spot Arwen. Bearer must be Aragorn.
Skirmish: Exert Aragorn or discard 2 cards from hand to make a minion skirmishing Aragorn strength -1.
lore: 'It is mine to give to whom I will... like my heart.'

title: Golradir
gametext:
To play, spot an Elf.
Skirmish: Exert Golradir to make an Orc strength -1.
lore: Their stay at Rivendell provided the Fellowship with counsel from many sources.
subtitle: Councilor of Imladris

title: Long-knives of Legolas
gametext:
Bearer must be Legolas.
Each Orc or Uruk-hai skirmishing Legolas is strength -2.
lore: Sharp, bone-handled knives defend the Elves of Mirkwood at close quarters.

title: Master of Healing
gametext: Fellowship or Regroup: Spot Elrond (or 2 [elven] allies) to heal a companion or ally.
lore: 'Elrond has cured you: he has tended you for days, ever since you were brought in.'

title: Nenya
gametext:
Bearer must be Galadriel.
At the start of each regroup phase, you may discard up to 2 cards from hand to draw the same number of cards.
lore: 'Verily it is in the land of Lórien upon the finger of Galadriel that one of the Three remains. This is Nenya, the Ring of Adamant, and I am its keeper.'

title: Phial of Galadriel
gametext:
To play, exert an Elf. Bearer must be the Ring-bearer.
Bearer's resistance is +2.
lore: 'May it be a light to you in dark places, when all other lights go out. Remember Galadriel and her Mirror!'

title: Saelbeth
gametext:
To play, spot an Elf.
Skirmish: Exert Saelbeth to make an Uruk-hai strength -1.
lore: The wisdom of Saelbeth prepared the Company for the dangers they would face.
subtitle: Elven Councilor

title: Something Draws Near
gametext: Fellowship or Maneuver: Exert an Elf to discard an [isengard] possession or [isengard] artifact.
lore: 'We have hunted and slain many Orcs in the woods....'

title: Vilya
gametext:
Bearer must be Elrond.
Maneuver: Exert Elrond twice and spot a Shadow condition to return that condition to its owner's hand.
lore: Upon his finger was a ring of gold with a great blue stone, Vilya, mightiest of the Three.

title: Voice of Nimrodel
gametext:
Tale.
Skirmish: Exert an Elf at a river or forest to cancel a skirmish involving that Elf.
lore: 'Beside the falls of Nimrodel, / By water clear and cool, / Her voice as falling silver fell / Into the shining pool.'

title: Betrayal of Isengard
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Each time an opponent draws a card (or takes a card into hand) during the Shadow phase, you may remove (1).
Maneuver: Exert Gandalf to wound Saruman twice.
lore: 'There is only one Lord of the Ring.'

title: Deep in Thought
gametext:
Spell.
Maneuver: Spot Gandalf and 4 twilight tokens to discard all Shadow conditions.
lore: He was... trying to recall every memory of his former journey in the Mines, and considering anxiously the next course that he should take....

title: Depart Silently
gametext:
Stealth.
Maneuver: At sites 1 to 5, spot Gandalf to prevent Hobbits from being assigned to skirmishes until the regroup phase. At any other site, spot Gandalf to make a Hobbit strength +3 until the regroup phase.
lore: 'Be careful, both of you.'

title: Fireworks
gametext:
Spell.
Fellowship: Spot Gandalf to shuffle up to 2 [gandalf] or up to 2 [shire] cards from your discard pile into your draw deck.
lore: 'The finest rockets ever seen: / they burst in stars of blue and green....'

texts: Shuffle up to two GANDALF cards
Shuffle up to two SHIRE cards

title: His First Serious Check
gametext: Maneuver: Spot Gandalf to reveal a card at random from an opponent's hand. You may add (X) to discard that card, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
lore: ...a false turn now might be disastrous.

true.text: Would you like to add twilight to discard {revealedCard}

title: Narya
gametext:
Bearer must be Gandalf.
At the start of each of your turns, you may add (3) to remove a burden.
lore: 'For this is the Ring of Fire, and with it you may rekindle hearts in a world that grows chill.'

title: Trust Me as You Once Did
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Skirmish: Exert Gandalf to make a companion strength +1 for each companion with the Gandalf signet you can spot (limit +3).
lore: 'Do not take me for some conjurer of cheap tricks! I am not trying to rob you. I am trying to help you.'

title: Unknown Perils
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Response: If a companion is about to take a wound, spot 4 twilight tokens and exert Gandalf to prevent that wound.
lore: Suddenly he stopped as if listening. Frodo became aware that all was very quiet, inside and outside.

title: Answering the Cries
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Skirmish: Discard a [gondor] tale from hand to make a [gondor] companion strength +2.
lore: Drawing his bright sword and crying Elendil! Elendil! he crashed through the trees.

title: Aragorn
gametext:
Ranger.
Each time the fellowship moves during the fellowship phase, remove (2).
lore: '...his hood was cast back, and his dark hair was blowing in the wind, a light was in his eyes: a king returning from exile in his own land.'
subtitle: Heir to the White City

title: Banner of the White Tree
gametext:
Tale.
Maneuver: Exert a [gondor] companion to make that companion strength +3 and defender +1 until the regroup phase.
lore: 'Many Elves and many mighty Men, and many of their friends, had perished in the war.'

title: Citadel of Minas Tirith
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
You may heal a [gondor] companion at the end of each turn during which no companion or ally lost a skirmish.
lore: 'One day our paths will lead us there, and the Tower guards shall take up the call – The Lords of Gondor have returned.'

title: Gondor Bowmen
gametext:
Tale. Plays to your support area.
Archery: Exert a [gondor] companion and discard this condition to make the fellowship archery total +2.
lore: Arrows of the Last Alliance brought death to Sauron's forces.

title: Horn of Boromir
gametext:
Bearer must be Boromir.
Maneuver: Exert Boromir and spot an ally. Until the regroup phase, that ally is strength +3 and participates in archery fire and skirmishes.
lore: On a baldric he wore a great horn tipped with silver....

effect.text: Choose ally to have it participate in archery and skirmishes

title: Might of Númenor
gametext:
Tale.
Maneuver: Spot a [gondor] companion to reveal a card at random from an opponent's hand. Heal X companions, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
lore: 'But the lords of Minas Tirith still fight on....'

title: The Shards of Narsil
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Fellowship: Stack a [gondor] card from hand here.
Fellowship: Add (1) to take a card stacked here into hand.
lore: '...Narsil was broken and its light extinguished, and it had not yet been forged again.'

effects.text: Stack a GONDOR card from hand here
Add (1) to take a card from here

effect.text: Choose a card to take into hand

title: Some Who Resisted
gametext:
Tale.
Maneuver: Spot a [gondor] companion to make the twilight cost of each maneuver event +2.
lore: 'In the South the realm of Gondor long endured; and for a while its splendour grew....'

title: Still Sharp
gametext: Skirmish: Spot The Shards of Narsil to make a [gondor] companion strength +3 and damage +1.
lore: 'The shards of Narsil... the blade that cut the Ring from Sauron's hand.'

title: Voice of Rauros
gametext: Maneuver: Exert Aragorn to make each companion with the Aragorn signet damage +1 until the regroup phase.
lore: As he ran the cries came louder, but fainter now and desperately the horn was blowing.

title: We Must Go Warily
gametext: Response: If the fellowship moves in the regroup phase, exert a [gondor] companion twice to make each minion's twilight cost +1 until the next regroup phase.
lore: 'This is the lawn of Parth Galen: a fair place in the summer days of old. Let us hope that no evil has yet come here.'

title: Abandoning Reason for Madness
gametext: Shadow: Spot an [isengard] minion to discard up to 3 cards from hand and draw an equal number of cards.
lore: 'And why not, Gandalf?... Why not? The Ruling Ring? If we could command that, then the power would pass to us.'

title: Can You Protect Me From Yourself?
gametext: Maneuver: Spot an [isengard] minion to exhaust Aragorn. The Free Peoples player may add 2 burdens to prevent this.
lore: 'Where is the Ring?'

effect.text: Would you like to add 2 burdens to prevent exhausting Aragorn?

title: Coming for the Ring
gametext: Regroup: Reveal a card at random from the Free Peoples player's hand. Heal X [isengard] minions, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
lore: 'This evil cannot be concealed by the power of the Elves....'

title: A Fell Voice on the Air
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Shadow: Exert Saruman to play an [isengard] weather condition from your discard pile. Its twilight cost is -2.
lore: 'He's trying to bring down the mountain!'

title: Hate and Anger
gametext: Shadow: Spot an Uruk-hai and a [moria] minion to draw 3 cards.
lore: The frenzy of Uruks is born of the fear of the very Goblins that work the pits.

title: Hollowing of Isengard
gametext:
To play, spot an [isengard] Orc. Plays to your support area.
Shadow: Discard this condition to add (3).
lore: 'Rip them all down!'

title: Isengard Axe
gametext:
Bearer must be an [isengard] Orc.
When you play this weapon, add (1).
lore: Axes eat into the forests of Isengard as well as the victims of Saruman's Orcs.

title: Isengard Forger
gametext: Shadow: Exert this minion to add (1).
lore: 'I looked on it and saw that, whereas it had once been green and fair, it was now filled with pits and forges.'

title: Isengard Retainer
gametext: Regroup: Exert this minion to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.
lore: '...the Eagles of the mountain went far and wide, and they saw many things: the gathering of wolves and the mustering of Orcs....'

title: Isengard Servant
gametext: Regroup: Exert this minion to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.
lore: The servants of Isengard worked tirelessly to spread the influence of their master.

title: Isengard Shaman
gametext: Response: If an [isengard] Orc is about to take a wound, remove (2) to prevent that wound.
lore: 'Over all his works a dark smoke hung and wrapped itself about the sides of Orthanc.'

title: Isengard Smith
gametext: Regroup: Exert this minion to discard a weapon (or all Free Peoples possessions if you can spot 5 companions).
lore: 'No other folk make such a trampling....'

title: Isengard Warrior
gametext:
While you can spot another [isengard] Orc, no player may use archery special abilities.
Regroup: Exert this minion and spot 3 wounds on the Ring-bearer to exert every companion.
lore: 'There is evil afoot in Isengard, and the West is no longer safe.'

title: Isengard Worker
gametext: Regroup: Exert this minion to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.
lore: 'They were Elves once. Taken by dark powers – tortured and mutilated....'

title: One of You Must Do This
gametext: Maneuver: Exert an [isengard] minion to make the Free Peoples player exert X companions, where X is the number of these races you can spot in the fellowship: Dwarf, Elf, Man, and Wizard.
lore: 'And if we fail, what then? What happens when Sauron takes back what is his?'

title: Orc Commander
gametext:
Each other [isengard] Orc is strength +1.
Regroup: Exert Orc Commander to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.
lore: 'It seems their delight to slash and beat down growing things that are not even in their way.'

title: Orc Overseer
gametext: Regroup: Exert Orc Overseer twice to exhaust a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
lore: 'What orders from Mordor, my Lord? What does the Eye command?'

title: Orthanc Berserker
gametext:
Damage +1.
Maneuver: Spot 5 burdens and exert Orthanc Berserker twice to exhaust a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
lore: The voice of Saruman compels his minions to stop at nothing to earn his favor.

title: The Palantír of Orthanc
gametext:
To play, spot an [isengard] minion. Plays to your support area.
Shadow: Spot an [isengard] minion and remove (1) to reveal a card at random from the Free Peoples player's hand. Place that card on top of that player's draw deck.
lore: 'Seven stars and seven stones....'

title: Saruman
gametext:
Saruman may not take wounds during the archery phase and may not be assigned to a skirmish.
Uruk-hai are fierce.
Response: If an Uruk-hai is about to take a wound, exert Saruman to prevent that wound.
subtitle: Keeper of Isengard

title: Saruman
gametext:
Saruman may not take wounds during the archery phase and may not be assigned to a skirmish.
Assignment: Exert Saruman to assign an [isengard] minion to a companion (except the Ring-bearer). That companion may exert to prevent this.

effect.preventText: Would you like to exert {assignedCompanion} to prevent it being assigned to {assignedMinion}

subtitle: Servant of the Eye

title: Servants to Saruman
gametext: Skirmish: Make an [isengard] Orc strength +2 (or +3 if you have fewer than 3 cards in hand).
lore: 'This is grievous news concerning Saruman... for we trusted him and he is deep in all our counsels.'

title: Tower of Orthanc
gametext:
To play, spot an [isengard] minion. Plays to your support area.
Each time the fellowship moves, you may spot an exhausted companion to add (3).
lore: 'It was not made by Saruman, but by the men of Númenor long ago; and it is very tall and has many secrets; yet it looks not to be a work of craft.'

title: Trapped and Alone
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Each character skirmishing an [isengard] Orc loses all damage bonuses from weapons.
lore: '...I had no chance of escape, and my days were bitter.'

title: The Trees Are Strong
gametext: Regroup: Discard X [isengard] Orcs to make the Free Peoples player wound X companions.
lore: 'Their roots go deep.'

title: Uruk Raider
gametext:
Damage +1.
While an ally is in the dead pile, this minion is strength +3 and fierce.
lore: There is no safety where Saruman's emblem is shown.

title: Uruk Ravager
gametext:
Damage +1.
When you play this minion, you may spot Saruman to add (2).
lore: '...a ruined and terrible form of life.'

title: Dangerous Gamble
gametext: Shadow: Spot a [moria] minion to reveal a card at random from the Free Peoples player's hand. Add (X), where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
lore: Almost they began to hope that they would escape.

title: Depths of Moria
gametext:
To play, spot a [moria] Orc. Plays to your support area.
Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, add (2).
lore: ...a great fissure had opened. Out of it a fierce red light came, and now and again flames licked at the brink.... Wisps of dark smoke wavered in the hot air.

title: Hide and Seek
gametext:
Search.
Skirmish: Spot 2 [shire] companions to make a [moria] minion damage +1.
lore: 'Which way shall we go?'

title: Malice
gametext: Archery: Spot a [moria] Orc and a [sauron] Orc to wound an archer.
lore: Fueled by Sauron's hatred of living things, Orcs searched for the Ring of Power.

title: Such a Little Thing
gametext: Maneuver: Spot a [moria] minion to wound Boromir 3 times. The Free Peoples player may discard 2 Free Peoples possessions to prevent this.
lore: 'Boromir... give the Ring to Frodo.'

effect.text: Would you like to discard 2 FP possession to prevent wounding Boromir 3 times?

title: Gates of the Dead City
gametext:
To play, spot a Nazgûl. Plays to your support area.
Each time a [wraith] card adds a burden, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion.
lore: '...and they took Minas Ithil and abode in it, and they made it into a place of dread....'

title: News of Mordor
gametext: Skirmish: Spot an [isengard] minion to make a Nazgûl damage +1.
lore: 'Build me an army worthy of Mordor.'

title: The Ring Draws Them
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Each time the fellowship moves, add (1) for each burden you can spot.
At the end of each of your Shadow phases, exert a Nazgûl or discard this condition.
lore: 'If I move I shall be seen and hunted!'

title: They Will Never Stop Hunting You
gametext: Maneuver: Spot a Nazgûl to reveal a card at random from the Free Peoples player's hand. Exert a companion bearing a ranged weapon X times, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
lore: 'They're looking for Baggins, and if they mean well, then I'm a hobbit.'

title: Too Great and Terrible
gametext: Maneuver: Spot a Nazgûl to wound Gandalf twice. The Free Peoples player may discard 2 [gandalf] cards from hand to prevent this.
lore: 'His eyes flashed and his face was lit as by a fire within. 'Do not tempt me! For I do not wish to become like the Dark Lord himself.'

effect.text: Would you like to discard 2 GANDALF cards from hand to prevent wounding Gandalf twice?

title: Úlairë Otsëa
gametext:
Twilight.
Each time Úlairë Otsëa wins a skirmish, you may exert him to transfer Blade Tip from your support area to the Ring-bearer.
lore: '...at all times they smell the blood of living things, desiring and hating it.'
subtitle: Ringwraith in Twilight

title: The Dark Lord Advances
gametext: Regroup: Exert a [sauron] minion to reveal a card at random from the Free Peoples player's hand. That player must discard X cards from hand, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
lore: 'A power was there that we have not felt before.'

title: Get Off the Road!
gametext:
Search.
Shadow: Spot a [sauron] minion and a Nazgûl to make the Free Peoples player discard a card from the top of his or her deck for each burden you can spot.
lore: 'The Morgul-lord and his Black Riders have come forth. War is preparing!'

title: Gleaming in the Snow
gametext: Regroup: Exert a [sauron] Orc and spot a [gondor] companion to add a burden.
lore: 'A Ring of Power looks after itself... It may slip off treacherously, but its keeper never abandons it.'

title: Hand of Sauron
gametext: Maneuver: Exert a [sauron] minion to make the Free Peoples player discard a card at random from his or her hand.
lore: 'The power of the Ring could not be undone.'

title: His Cruelty and Malice
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Regroup: Exert a [sauron] minion to make the Free Peoples player discard the top card from his or her draw deck.
lore: 'Into this Ring he poured his cruelty, his malice, and his will to dominate all life.'

title: Massing in the East
gametext: Regroup: Exert a [sauron] minion to discard a card from the top of the Free Peoples player's draw deck for each of these races you can spot in the fellowship: Dwarf, Elf, Man, and Wizard.
lore: 'The power of the Black Land grows....'

title: Morgul Slayer
gametext: Regroup: Exert this minion to wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
lore: 'Sauron was diminished, but not destroyed. His Ring was lost but not unmade.'

title: Orc Butcher
gametext: For each [sauron] condition you can spot, this minion is strength +1.
lore: 'And yet we see that Sauron can torture and destroy the very hills.'

title: Orc Guard
gametext: Maneuver: Exert this minion and discard your [sauron] condition to discard a Free Peoples condition.
lore: The malice of the Dark Tower thins the hopes of Men.

title: Orc Pillager
gametext: For each Free Peoples card borne by a character this minion is skirmishing, that character is strength -1.
lore: Weapons of the West are often powerless against the threat of Sauron.

title: Orc Slayer
gametext: Regroup: Exert this minion to wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
lore: For it is a long tale, full of deeds great and terrible....

title: Orc Swordsman
gametext: While this minion bears a weapon, he is strength +2.
lore: 'Many evil things there are that your strong walls and bright swords do not stay.'

title: Orc Trooper
gametext: For each card in your hand, this minion is strength +1.
lore: The Dark Lord's power grows in unseen ways.

title: Orc Veteran
gametext: Skirmish: Discard your [sauron] condition to make a character skirmishing this minion strength -1.
lore: 'There was war, and the land was laid waste....'

title: Orc Warrior
gametext: Maneuver: Exert this minion and discard your [sauron] condition to make the Free Peoples player discard the top 2 cards from his or her draw deck.
lore: Orcs were multiplying again in the mountains.

title: Our List of Allies Grows Thin
gametext:
To play, exert a [sauron] minion. Plays to your support area.
Each time the fellowship moves, add (1) for each ally you can spot.
lore: 'The enemy is moving.... His eye is fixed on Rivendell. And Saruman, you tell me, has betrayed us.'

title: Terrible as the Dawn
gametext: Maneuver: Spot a [sauron] minion to wound Galadriel 3 times. The Free Peoples player may discard 2 Elves to prevent this.
lore: 'In the place of the Dark Lord, you would have a Queen... All shall love me and despair!'

effect.text: Would you like to discard 2 Elves to prevent wounding Galadriel 3 times?

title: Tower of Barad-dûr
gametext:
To play, exert a [sauron] minion. Plays to your support area.
Each time the fellowship moves, the Free Peoples player must discard a card from hand.
lore: The Dark Tower had been rebuilt, it was said. From there the power was spreading....

title: Why Shouldn't I Keep It?
gametext: Maneuver: Spot a [sauron] minion to discard Bilbo. The Free Peoples player may discard 2 Free Peoples conditions to prevent this.
lore: 'No, wait, it's here in my pocket. Isn't that... isn't that odd now?'

effect.text: Would you like to discard 2 FP conditions to prevent discarding Bilbo?

title: Bill the Pony
gametext:
Bearer must be a Hobbit companion.
The Shadow number of each site is -1.
Discard Bill the Pony when at an underground site.
lore: 'That animal can nearly talk.... He gave me a look as plain as Mr. Pippin could speak....'

title: Frodo's Pipe
gametext:
Bearer must be Frodo.
Fellowship: Discard a pipeweed possession and spot X pipes to heal a companion with the Frodo signet X times.
lore: 'All the same, observations that I have made on my own many journeys south have convinced me that the weed itself is not native to our parts of the world.'

title: Frying Pan
gametext:
Bearer must be a Hobbit.
Skirmish: Exert bearer to wound an Orc he or she is skirmishing.
lore: 'I think I'm getting the hang of this!'

title: Meant to Be Alone
gametext: Fellowship: Spot a Hobbit companion (except the Ring-bearer) to reveal a card at random from an opponent's hand. Remove (X), where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
lore: 'You are a Ring-bearer, Frodo... to bear a Ring of Power is to be alone.'

title: Melilot Brandybuck
gametext: Response: If a burden is about to be added by a Shadow card, exert Melilot Brandybuck to prevent that burden.
lore: Master Everard Took and Miss Melilot Brandybuck got on a table and with bells in their hands began to dance the Springle-ring: a pretty dance, but rather 'vigorous.
subtitle: Merry Dancer

title: Old Noakes
gametext: Each time a Shadow card makes you discard a card from hand, you may also discard a minion or Shadow condition.
lore: 'There's been some strange folk crossing the Shire – Dwarves and others of a less than savoury nature.'
subtitle: Purveyor of Wisdoms

title: Seek and Hide
gametext:
Stealth.
Skirmish: Spot 2 [shire] companions to make a minion lose all damage bonuses.
lore: A Hobbit's best friends in Moria are the very pillars that support its structure.

title: The Shire Countryside
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [shire] companions. Plays to your support area.
Each time you remove a burden (except by a Hobbit's game text), you may heal a companion.
lore: 'Life in the wide world goes on... scarcely even aware of the existence of hobbits....'

title: Three Monstrous Trolls
gametext:
Tale. Plays to your support area.
Response: If a Shadow card is about to add any number of twilight tokens, exert a Hobbit ally to prevent this.
lore: 'Great big nasty twenty foot high smelly things – and they're arguing... arguing about how they were going to cook us!'

title: Caras Galadhon
gametext: Forest. Sanctuary. While the fellowship is at Caras Galadhon, no more than one minion may be assigned to each skirmish.

title: Eregion Hills
gametext: When the fellowship moves to Eregion Hills, add a burden.

title: Gates of Argonath
gametext: River. Maneuver events may not be played.

title: The Great River
gametext: River. While the fellowship is at The Great River, cards may not be played from draw decks or discard piles.

title: House of Elrond
gametext: Sanctuary. When the fellowship moves to House of Elrond, the Free Peoples player may spot 2 Elves to remove a burden.

title: Wastes of Emyn Muil
gametext: Maneuver: Spot 4 companions and exert your [isengard] Orc to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.

title: Legolas
gametext:
Archer.
While Legolas is at a river or forest, add 1 to the fellowship archery total.
lore: 'Praised be the bow of Galadriel, and the hand and eye of Legolas!... That was a mighty shot in the dark, my friend!'
subtitle: Son of Thranduil

title: Boromir
gametext:
Ranger.
Fellowship: Add (2) to heal Boromir.
lore: ...seated a little apart was a tall man with a fair and noble face... proud and stern of glance.
subtitle: Defender of Minas Tirith
